summary: Documents # prefix mismatch, AWB only in OSR other_id, total_tcs_amount=0, brand mostly null, freebie SKU RD_0325_05 at ₹1, HSN fallback fields, multi-row orders, group_level_id=211 primary and 22 minor.
Mandatory filters include is_active=true, group_level_id=211 for Astrotalk analysis, metadata-specific filters for sales/reverse/cancel and charged_amount>1 to exclude freebies from revenue.
GST classification uses source/destination state and IGST versus CGST+SGST tax fields; product HSN fallback may be needed.

source_section: 2. Table Overview — The Critical Join; Entity Relationships
summary: Correct join is # || unicommerce.order_id = unicommerce_order_sales_report.order_id; direct join has low coverage while prefixed join reaches 91.1% documented coverage.

Forward sales, Courier Return/RTO, Customer Return and Cancellation lifecycle are represented with metadata and transaction_type values in unicommerce, with OSR shipment status complement where applicable.

Cancellation occurs after order placement but before dispatch; unicommerce records metadata=cancel, transaction_type COD/PREPAID, cancellation invoice, and OSR order_status=CANCELLED where shipment complement exists.
supported_semantics: metadata=cancel and transaction_type COD/PREPAID for cancellation

summary: Customer return begins after buyer receives the item and initiates return; Unicommerce creates a reverse entry with metadata=reverse, transaction_type=Customer Return, charged_amount as original sale value, followed by item return and refund processing.
supported_semantics: metadata=reverse and transaction_type=Customer Return for buyer-initiated return
charged_amount equals original sale value for customer return analysis

summary: Forward sale starts with customer order through Astrotalk app/website/marketplace, Unicommerce OMS receives the order, GST invoice is generated, unicommerce metadata=sales with COD/PREPAID transaction_type and INSEG-style sales invoice, then OSR moves MANIFESTED to DISPATCHED and finally DELIVERED.
supported_semantics: metadata=sales and transaction_type COD/PREPAID for forward sale
invoice_number sales invoice pattern such as INSEG-25-26-XXXXX
OSR order_status progression MANIFESTED to DISPATCHED to DELIVERED

summary: RTO begins after courier delivery failure, courier triggers Return-to-Origin, unicommerce records metadata=reverse and transaction_type=Courier Return with SRFZ stock-return/credit-note invoice semantics, and OSR may show RESHIPPED or CANCELLED after the item returns.
supported_semantics: metadata=reverse and transaction_type=Courier Return for RTO
invoice_number SRFZ-style stock return credit-note semantics
OSR order_status RESHIPPED if redispatched or CANCELLED if abandoned

summary: metadata is the single source of truth: sales for forward sales, reverse for Courier Return/RTO and Customer Return, cancel for pre-dispatch cancellations; transaction_type refines COD/PREPAID and return subtype.

Unicommerce is an OMS/operations-invoice layer, not a marketplace settlement source; it aggregates marketplace, D2C, quick-commerce, courier and accounting integrations while marketplace payout tables remain separate.

ZenStatement Unicommerce pipeline has zs_observe.unicommerce financial/invoice view for sales, returns and cancellations, plus zs_observe.unicommerce_order_sales_report shipment/logistics view with AWB, delivery status, shipping method and MRP.
